name: yt-looper
description: A practical A/B looper and custom-speed controller for YouTube.

scripts.build:all: npm run build:firefox && npm run build:chrome && npm run build:safari
scripts.lint: npm run lint:code && npm run lint:styles && npm run lint:html && npm run lint:yaml && npm run lint:docs
scripts.lint:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.lint:extension: npm run lint:firefox && npm run lint:chrome && npm run lint:safari
scripts.check:quick: npm run release:verify && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
scripts.check: npm run release:verify && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage && npm run deadcode && npm run lint:extension && npm run size && npm run perf
scripts.check:full: npm run check && npm run security:audit && npm run security:signatures && npm run deps:freshness
scripts.firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist/chrome
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir artifacts/chrome --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:safari: npm run build:safari && web-ext build --source-dir dist/safari --artifacts-dir artifacts/safari --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:all: npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome && npm run package:safari
